about_the_game:
If you enjoyed our anniversary free-to-play title, The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show, and want to give the Rusty Lake team a gift for our 10th birthday, this pack is for you!
This special DLC is our way of thanking you for your continued love and enthusiasm for Rusty Lake.

Included in this pack:
✉️ A heartfelt thank-you letter from the Rusty Lake team
🖼️ Exclusive wallpapers – perfect for your desktop or mobile device
🎩 Some extra in-game decorations – this is a purely cosmetic in-game add-on

Please keep in mind: This pack will only be available at the end of the game and it doesn’t contain any extra puzzle content or secrets/achievements. Getting this DLC is primarily a way to show your support for Rusty Lake. The perks listed above are just a bonus!

By purchasing this pack, you help us keep creating the eerie, surreal, and unforgettable experiences you love, like our upcoming title: Servant of the Lake. Thank you for being part of the Rusty Lake family!
